evaluation_protocol.mapping: one-to-one Hungarian assignment learned on cfc_train
evaluation_protocol.missing_values: scientifically unavailable cells are null, never zero-filled
evaluation_protocol.representation_check: train-selected decoder axis oriented by its train correlation, then compared with factor-times-delta-z on cfc_test

reverse_response_audit.hard_gate_policy: record the finite raw reversal discrepancy without a maximum-error gate after exact antipodal checkpoint constraints pass; hard threshold and rank boundaries are discontinuous in floating-point arithmetic

evaluation_protocol.sparsity_measurement: absolute response only for support/AUC metrics

dci_c.protocol: probe fit on cfc_train responses and evaluated on cfc_test

dci_i.protocol: probe fit on cfc_train responses and evaluated on cfc_test

decoder_projection_mcc_p.definition: Pearson MCC after projecting delta-z onto decoder axes.
decoder_projection_mcc_p.protocol: axis assignment learned on cfc_train and held fixed on cfc_test

mcc_p.definition: Mean absolute Pearson correlation under a one-to-one assignment.
mcc_p.protocol: assignment learned on cfc_train and held fixed on cfc_test

mcc_s.definition: Mean absolute Spearman correlation under a one-to-one assignment.
mcc_s.protocol: assignment learned on cfc_train and held fixed on cfc_test

r2.definition: Linear explicitness of factor changes from the full response.
r2.protocol: linear map fit on cfc_train and evaluated on cfc_test

reconstruction_mse.definition: Mean squared reconstruction error in raw embedding units.
reconstruction_mse.protocol: cfc_test inputs in each model's trained input regime

reconstruction_nmse.definition: Mean squared error divided by held-out target power.
reconstruction_nmse.protocol: cfc_test inputs in each model's trained input regime

sae_auc.definition: One-to-one feature ROC-AUC for factor support.
sae_auc.protocol: factor support is factor != 0; feature magnitude is selected on cfc_train and evaluated on cfc_test

support_f1.definition: F1 of the Pearson-matched response's active support.

support_precision.definition: Precision of the Pearson-matched response's active support.

support_recall.definition: Recall of the Pearson-matched response's active support.
